data.name: Welcome_Title
data.value: Welcome

data.name: Welcome_Description
data.value: Welcome to the RayMigrator Configuration Wizard. This wizard guides you through creating a complete RayMigrator configuration file step by step.

data.name: Root_Title
data.value: RayMigrator Configuration

data.name: Root_Description
data.value: This is the root of your RayMigrator configuration. The configuration is organized into sections: Repository, DatabaseLogging, ProductDefaults, Products, Serilog, and CliTools.

data.name: Repository_Title
data.value: Repository

data.name: Repository_Description
data.value: The Repository stores migration tracking data (which migrations have been applied, their status, and hashes). Configure the database engine, connection string, schema, and timeout settings.

data.name: DatabaseLogging_Title
data.value: Database Logging

data.name: DatabaseLogging_Description
data.value: Optional feature that writes log entries to a database table in addition to Serilog console/file logging. Useful for centralized log analysis and auditing migration runs across environments.

data.name: ProductDefaults_Title
data.value: Product Defaults

data.name: ProductDefaults_Description
data.value: Default values inherited by all Products. Individual products can override any of these values. Includes error actions, file extensions, encoding, and nested TargetGroup/Target defaults.

data.name: Product_Title
data.value: Product

data.name: Product_Description
data.value: A Product is a deployable unit that contains migration files. Each product has its own directory of migration files organized by release. Products can override ProductDefaults values.

data.name: TargetGroup_Title
data.value: Target Group

data.name: TargetGroup_Description
data.value: A Target Group contains one or more Targets that share the same DatabaseType. Migration files are applied to all targets in the group. Configure the database engine, migration order, and hash validation.

data.name: Target_Title
data.value: Target

data.name: Target_Description
data.value: A Target is a single database instance where migrations are applied. Configure the connection string and optionally override timeout, retry, and CLI tool settings.

data.name: Serilog_Title
data.value: Serilog

data.name: Serilog_Description
data.value: Logging configuration using the Serilog framework. Configure the minimum log level, per-namespace overrides, and output sinks (Console, File, etc.).

data.name: CliTools_Title
data.value: CLI Tools

data.name: CliTools_Description
data.value: External command-line tools (e.g., sqlcmd, psql, mariadb, mysql, sqlite3) that can be used instead of RayMigrator's built-in database drivers for executing migration SQL.

data.name: Products_Title
data.value: Products

data.name: Products_Description
data.value: Container for all configured products. A Product is a deployable unit with its own migration files and target databases.

data.name: TargetGroups_Title
data.value: Target Groups

data.name: TargetGroups_Description
data.value: Container for target groups within a product. Each target group shares a DatabaseType and contains one or more target databases.

data.name: Targets_Title
data.value: Targets

data.name: Targets_Description
data.value: Container for targets within a target group. Each target is a single database instance where migrations are applied.
